additionalProperties.value: Confirmed startup copy path; addresses in this raw import are FILE OFFSETS. Let P be the runtime address of file offset 0x800; incoming r0 = 0x22000000 - P. Copies P -> 0x22000000, length 0xAED8; clears 0x2200AED8..0x22010774 (exclusive); adjusts LR by relocation delta at file 0x90E8 and continues in IRAM. Copies P+0xAED8 -> 0x08000000 length 0xA0FC88, then P+0xA1AB60 -> 0x08A0FC88 length 0xA84. Finally BX 0x22000000 restarts relocated vector. Copy helper 0x8D4 handles overlapping ranges. Runtime mapping: IRAM = file-0x800+0x22000000; main DRAM = file-0xB6D8+0x08000000. These are fixed section copies, not pointer fixups. Direct plaintext boot has not been tested.

Early startup dependency, reached via file 0x422C -> veneer 0x3DE8 -> runtime 0x0835ED5C (this file offset). Calls file 0x2BD84C with r0=0x18; helper returns 0x2203FF00+r0. Requires word at 0x2203FF18 == 0x53797349; mismatch returns 0x52. Reads source pointer from 0x2203FF1C, copies 0x120 bytes to runtime 0x08A11CD8. Startup later reads this structure's +0xE0 size and +0xE4 base to establish DRAM mappings. Strong evidence of boot-stage handoff data; producer and complete descriptor format not established from this image.
